kind.description: Which of the three kinds of caller this is: a `developer` working through the console, an `app_user` holding a token from a client login, or a `server_key` used by server-side code. Stated outright rather than left to be inferred from which id happens to be set.

developer_id.description: The Fleetless user behind this session, or `null` when `kind` is not `developer`.

app_user_id.description: The app user behind this session, or `null` when `kind` is not `app_user`. An app user belongs to exactly one app and is unrelated to any Fleetless user with the same address.

server_key_id.description: The server key this session was authenticated with, or `null` when `kind` is not `server_key`.

app_id.description: The app this session belongs to, and `null` for a developer — a developer is organisation-scoped and owns the configuration of every robot in the organisation rather than reaching one through an app.

role_id.description: The role that decides what this caller may reach, and `null` for a developer. Roles are the only visibility filter: what a role does not grant does not exist for that user.

email.description: The address of the Fleetless user or app user behind this session, and `null` for a server key, which is not a person.
